pages.title: Oil and gas well blowouts — ONGC Sivasagar

facts.text: Event: blowout at an ONGC well in Sivasagar district, Assam on 12 June 2025
facts.head: News

facts.text: Evacuated: over 1,500 residents
facts.head: News

facts.text: Experts: well-control experts from the United States
facts.head: News

facts.text: Controlled: by 21 June
facts.head: News

facts.text: Blowout: uncontrolled release of gas/oil when well pressure beats blowout preventers (BOPs) and drilling mud
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Causes: faulty valves, wrong mud weight; fire if ignited
facts.head: Background

facts.text: ⚠ Hard to control — needs experts, days or weeks
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Coined by: Meetpal S. Kukal (University of Idaho) and Mike Hobbins (University of Colorado/NOAA) — Earth's Future, March 2025
facts.head: News

facts.text: Definition: three or more consecutive days of high atmospheric evaporative demand (EED)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Measured by: standardised short-crop evapotranspiration (ET₀) — theoretical 12 cm grass crop
facts.head: News

facts.text: Drivers: temperature, low humidity, wind, solar radiation — ⚠ not temperature alone; ⚠ not about rainfall
facts.head: News

facts.text: India studies: Chattopadhyay & Hulme (1997) — PET declined 1960s–90s; IIT Roorkee & NIH (2022) — rising actual ET in North India, Himalayas
facts.head: News

facts.text: Indian collaborator: Shailza Sharma (NIT Jalandhar)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Aspect: Based on; Heatwave: high air temperature; Thirstwave: high evaporative demand
facts.head: News

facts.text: Aspect: Impact; Heatwave: human health; Thirstwave: crop water stress
facts.head: News

pages.title: Dravidogecko coonoor — new gecko from Nilgiris

facts.text: Species: Dravidogecko coonoor — endemic to Coonoor, Upper Nilgiris, Tamil Nadu (Western Ghats)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Discovered by: A. Abinesh, R.S. Naveen, A.N. Srikanthan, S. Babu, S.R. Ganesh
facts.head: News

facts.text: Earlier thought: Hemidactylus anamallensis (now Dravidogecko anamallensis)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Count: nine Dravidogecko species in Western Ghats
facts.head: News

facts.text: Habitat: shola forests, plantations, building walls
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Found entirely outside protected areas
facts.head: News

facts.text: Western Ghats: one of the world's eight "hottest hotspots"
facts.head: News
